messages:
maria_sec: Alert from observability — sudden 6x spike in KMS Decrypts for key prod-llm-data around 1890043200. Rate sustained ~900/s for 3m. Noted unusual principal: serviceAccount:ml-ingest@redwood-prod.

josh_oncall: copying. markers: latency fine, error rate stable. Are these expected by ML batch jobs?

terri_sre: not from our scheduled batches, those run at :00 and :30. This spike came at :07. Looks like a bursty stream.

ali_engineer: /cc @maria_sec I deployed a transform yesterday but it uses a different SA. Checking deployments now.

incidentbot: Incident created — INC-2026-1890043210 — KMS decrypt spike (prod-llm-data). Severity: high. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/kms-spike

maria_sec: Triage plan: 1) Confirm principal and resources via audit logs 2) Quarantine SA if unrecognized 3) Rotate data key (quick re-wrap) 4) Start a read-only traffic mirror for deeper forensics 5) Notify compliance. Assigning roles: Josh = command, Terri = infra actions, Ali = app dev liaison, Maria = security lead.

josh_oncall: ack. I'll coordinate comms and stakeholder pings. 

terri_sre: Running audit query now. GCP KMS logs:
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND jsonPayload.event.subtype="KMS_DECRYPT" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"ml-ingest"' --limit 50 --project=redwood-prod
```

terri_sre: Initial results: ~420 decrypt events from ml-ingest@redwood-prod over 2m, many from node pool autoscaler nodes i-ml-*. IP ranges include a few EU addresses we don't recognize.

ali_engineer: I can temporarily revoke the SA key binding from the KMS IAM role. But that will break live ingestion. Propose to revoke, then failover ingesters to a queued mode. Thoughts?

maria_sec: Yes revoke binding to stop decrypts immediately. Prepare a mitigation doc so customer-facing teams can explain a short ingestion delay. Use short downtime comms.

josh_oncall: Terri, do the revoke. Ali, prepare config to flip ingesters to queued mode (feature flag). I'll post a brief incident blurb to #incidents and pager teams.

terri_sre: Executing revoke:
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/llm/cryptoKeys/prod-llm-data" --member="serviceAccount:ml-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter" --project=redwood-prod
```

terri_sre: Binding removed. Observability: decrypt rate dropped to ~10/s in 30s. Good.

ali_engineer: Flipping ingesters to queued fallback now (feature-flag: ingest_mode=queued). Deploying rollout canary to 5% then 100%.

ali_engineer: Canary good, rolling to 100%. Ingestion fallback engaged. No new decrypts from ml-ingest.

maria_sec: Good containment. Next immediate actions: rotate (re-wrap) the data key and rotate any long-lived keys that SA had access to. Also collect full audit export and persistent packet capture for the suspicious IPs.

josh_oncall: On comms: sending short note to security@, infra@, and product leads. Will escalate to compliance for customer notification guidance.

terri_sre: KMS key re-wrap started: generating new key version and setting as primary:
```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key="prod-llm-data" --project=redwood-prod && gcloud kms keys versions set-primary <new_version> --key="prod-llm-data" --project=redwood-prod
```

maria_sec: Forensics: please snapshot the node pool instances flagged (i-ml-*) and export auth logs. Tag all artifacts with INC-2026-1890043210.

ali_engineer: Snapshot requests queued. Also checking deploy logs for any suspicious CI commits or tokens. Nothing obvious so far.

josh_oncall: Who is taking first-response handoff in 20 minutes? I'll need to step out for a customer call.

maria_sec: I'll handoff to @terri_sre as incident commander at 1890043625. Terri, you get the bridge and narrative for next shift.

terri_sre: ack taking handoff at 1890043625. I'll continue containment verifications, collect forensic artifacts, and draft post-incident checklist.

incidentbot: INC-2026-1890043210 status updated: containment in progress -> contained. Next: forensic collection and RCA.

maria_sec: Post-incident actions (to include in RCA): audit RBAC roles for all KMS bindings, enforce short-lived creds for ingestion SA, add anomaly alerting for principal-specific decrypt rates, add IPTables egress blocklist for suspicious IPs, and update runbook steps to include queued fallback play.

josh_oncall: Thanks team. I'll publish a short incident note and handoff log in 5. :thumbsup:

terri_sre: Handed off. Leaving a sparse timeline in the incident doc and pointers to logs.

maria_sec: Closing interim update. Compliance and legal looped in. We'll reconvene tomorrow for RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
